source.title: Building Data Genome 2 — raw hourly water meters
source.attribution: Miller et al. and Building Data Genome 2 contributors (2020)
source.locationNote: Anonymized Panther education buildings at a US reference site. These are not London campus measurements.
notes: Original local timestamps contain no UTC offset; daily totals follow the dataset's 24-row local-day convention.
Raw readings are retained, without interpolation, winsorization, or hidden zero removal.
Whole-building water is not automatically eligible non-potable demand.
Clipped data and derived benchmark artifacts retain upstream Attribution-ShareAlike terms separately from application code.

split.policy: Fixed chronological train / validation / test. Parameters frozen before test; no test refitting.

dataQuality.exclusionPolicy: A target needs all 24 valid nonnegative raw hourly readings and seven complete preceding days.
